about_the_game:
Do you have the Big Dig Energy it takes to go deeper than anyone before? Grab your pickaxe, call your bearded brethren, and embrace the life of a Big Dig Dwarf in the best digging game ever!

Dig Deep – Smash through dirt, rocks, and whatever questionable substances lurk below. The deeper you go, the richer the rewards… and the weirder the surprises.

Upgrades – Your puny starter tools won’t cut it in the depths. Sell your loot for energy, upgrade your gear, and dig like a legendary dwarf should.

4-Player Co-Op – Who needs solo mining when you can bring your crew? Team up with up to 3 other dwarves, gain energy, and experience underground mayhem together.

What Lurks Below – Not everything down there is safe. The deeper you go, the more you'll regret not bringing bigger tools... and maybe some explosives.

There’s no rush, no rules—just beards and Big Dig Energy. Get ready to dig like you’ve never dug before!

By purchasing my game you support me, "Mike", a solo indie developer. I plan to produce updates to the game to bring a more enjoyable experience and expand on the content. Thanks for your support!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64Bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2500K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 780 3GB or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 4790K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 1080 8GB or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Do you have the Big Dig Energy!? The best co-op mining game with online and split-screen multiplayer for up to 4 players! Team up, dig deep, mine energy ore, and upgrade your tools. Reach the planets core to fuel the rocket and leave Earth!
